p59.whyDeferralDoesNotDisturbOrdering: every determinate replacement obligation now open has a selectionIndex strictly below 59 (29, 30, 38, 42, 45, 51, 54). p59.becomesAStopCondition: if P:59 becomes decision-relevant to window ordering or to corpus closure, the autopilot STOPS and the owner decides. It is never silently resolved

p6.rule: reserveConsumed > P6_MAX_REPLACEMENTS_BEFORE_SUCCESS_FLOOR AND successfulOrganisationCount < P6_SUCCESS_FLOOR (both frozen at 10 and 50)
p6.evaluationNow: 10 > 10 is false AND 52 < 50 is false. Both arms false
p6.whyItIsClearedRatherThanWaived: nothing about P6 changed. Its first arm is now permanently true and its second arm is false because 52 successful organisations exist. The rule is evaluated unchanged and simply does not fire
p6.wouldFireAgainIf: the canonical successful count ever fell below 50 while reserveConsumed exceeded 10. Successes are append-only in practice, but the rule is evaluated mechanically after every ledger change rather than assumed stable

scope.windowSizeRule: exactly 5 whenever at least five executable work items remain; a shorter final window recomputes its own P2 and P5 counts through strictPercentThresholdCount(size, percent) and never inherits the five-item values
scope.reserveAssignmentsAuthorised: as many as the window-construction algorithm derives, bounded by 20 live attempts, 4 windows and the 40-position frozen reserve

windowConstructionAlgorithm.name: DETERMINATE_Q1_REPLACEMENTS_BEFORE_NEW_PRIMARIES
steps: STEP 1 - independently recompute every current determinate replacement obligation from the committed adjudication chain and the database, never from a carried-forward total
STEP 2 - sort them by selectionIndex ASCENDING, per Owner Clarification Q1
STEP 3 - assign unused reserve positions monotonically in frozen reserve-rank order
STEP 4 - take up to FIVE replacement work items first
STEP 5 - if fewer than five determinate obligations exist, fill the remaining positions with NEVER_STARTED primaries in ascending selectionIndex order
neverTrust: planPendingReplacementObligations for Q1 ORDERING - it is the position authority only
prepareReplacementAppend as proof that a slot is genuinely obligated
windowConstructionAlgorithm.knownToolingFinding: prepareReplacementAppend accepts an append for a slot with no determinate obligation: it checks the planner's ordering and the reason vocabulary, not obligation existence. Helper acceptance is NECESSARY BUT NOT SUFFICIENT. Every append must be compared, one assignment at a time, against canonical obligation state derived independently
windowConstructionAlgorithm.adapterCannotDetectAForgedSuccessCount: at any ledger entryCount, a strategy's stated ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL is checked only for internal consistency with the P6 arms it also states. Governance, not the adapter, holds the success count
windowConstructionAlgorithm.generationSuccessCountUsedByTheLiveGate: the canonical count AT WINDOW START; it is never incremented from live diagnostics inside that window

order: strategy - bound to the STARTING (pre-append) ledger revision
plan - built through the landed generic builders from those exact strategy bytes and that exact starting ledger
pre-network ledger append - the reserve positions the plan names are appended and committed BEFORE any institution socket
LIVE_RESULT with its single full-repository validation
stageOrderingWithinAWindow.whyTheStrategyBindsThePreAppendLedger: the landed adapter (windowSpecFromAcquisitionWindowStrategy) derives a replacement's reserve position from planPendingReplacementObligations against the ledger the strategy BINDS, and that planner returns entryCount + offset. A strategy binding a ledger that already contained the appended rows would derive positions 15..19, not 10..14, and the adapter would refuse it. The starting-ledger binding is therefore the pre-append revision by construction
stageOrderingWithinAWindow.whereTheNewLedgerIsProved: the P7 preflight takes the LIVE ledger, not the bound one. After the append it holds 15 entries, and P7 requires: the live ledger's 10-entry prefix hash equals the bound starting ledgerHash; no entry beyond the prefix except the planned ones; every planned assignment actually recorded; and every replacement item's current occupant already RESERVE_REPLACEMENT at its assigned position. Those last two are satisfiable ONLY after the append
stageOrderingWithinAWindow.soTheGateSeesFifteen: at the live gate, generationReserveConsumedCount is 15 and the validated ledger holds 15 entries. P7's reserve-count arm compares the two and P6 is re-evaluated on 15 and 52
stageOrderingWithinAWindow.followsLandedPrecedent: this is the ordering the post-P18 second window (c82f488) and the post-P24 window (3eb2733) used: strategy, plan, authority, then an 'append reserve N pre-network' commit. It is not a new convention

ifAReserveOccupyingSlotSIsUnsuccessful: create a NEW replacement obligation for the SAME slot S
do NOT insert a second reserve for S into the current live window
the next assignment happens only at a NEW precommitted window
replacementFailureChain.consequence: a failed low-index replacement may sort AHEAD of higher-index obligations in the next window. The next window's composition is therefore never precommitted before the current one is adjudicated
replacementFailureChain.reasonForTheNewObligation: derived under Owner Clarification Q3's precedence from that reserve's own evidence, never inherited from the original occupant's failure

firstWindowUnderThisDecision.name: POST_P6_Q1_WINDOW_01
firstWindowUnderThisDecision.why: the Q1 queue holds seven determinate obligations, which is more than five, so STEP 5 does not run
excludes: any reserve position at or beyond 15
firstWindowUnderThisDecision.precommittedHereNote: the composition above is DERIVED and stated so the first window can be checked against it. The precommitment itself is the window's own strategy and plan records, which are what a live authority may bind

laterWindowsAreNotPrecommittedHere.statement: no composition beyond POST_P6_Q1_WINDOW_01 is precommitted by this record
laterWindowsAreNotPrecommittedHere.why: if any Window 01 replacement is unsuccessful, Q2 creates a same-slot obligation whose selectionIndex may sort ahead of 51 and 54, changing the next window. The algorithm is recomputed from scratch after every adjudication
laterWindowsAreNotPrecommittedHere.illustrativeOnly: were all five of Window 01 successful, the remaining obligations would be 51 and 54 and the next window would begin with replacements for them followed by the next untouched primaries from 60. This is an ILLUSTRATION, not a commitment

validationPolicy.fullValidationRequired: exactly once per LIVE WINDOW, after live acquisition terminates and the LIVE_RESULT draft is complete AND FORMATTED
validationPolicy.why: none of those records changes executable code
beforeSpendingTheOneFullValidation: Prettier formatting of the new LIVE_RESULT
validationPolicy.d1LessonEncodedHere: the D1 window started its single full validation before the LIVE_RESULT had been formatted, and the run failed on format:check. That one validation was spent. Formatting now precedes the quiet gate explicitly
validationPolicy.fullValidationProcedure: a 120-second correctness-critical quiet gate, self-excluding, chained directly into one caffeinate -dimsu npm run validate in a single process
validationPolicy.doesNotBlockOn: unrelated CPU or container load from other projects
validationPolicy.onFailureOrContamination: STOP; no automatic rerun; the owner must explicitly decide any rerun
validationPolicy.revokedIf: any code, test, harness, fetch policy, migration or methodology implementation change becomes necessary - the cadence then STOPS

hostRequirements.acPowerNote: the previous cadence REQUIRED AC. This decision makes AC optional, which is a deliberate owner relaxation recorded here so the change is visible rather than inferred
hostRequirements.caffeinateDoesNotStopClamshellSleep: a closed lid sleeps the host regardless of caffeinate -dimsu. The lid stays open
hostRequirements.sleepWakeOrDarkWakeDuringAnItem: preserve evidence, STOP, no target rerun, no next item, route to incident review
hostRequirements.sleepWakeOrDarkWakeDuringFullValidation: the validation is contaminated; STOP; no automatic rerun
hostRequirements.hostTimingIsSleepAdjusted: elapsed wall-clock minus pmset-reported sleep is what may be called slow; raw elapsed time across a sleep is not evidence of a slow host

a widened page, request or host budget
a browser, curl or wget request
a dynamic reserve replacement inside a live window
afterEveryItem: verify the ledger is unchanged since the precommitted append

adjudicationRules.ifReplacementSuccessful: the selection slot becomes successful with that reserve as its current occupant
adjudicationRules.ifReplacementUnsuccessful: create a new SAME-SLOT replacement obligation under Q2; do not assign the next reserve during the same window
adjudicationRules.ifSd7RangeCrosses4: leave that slot PENDING_CAPABILITY_REVIEW and STOP the autopilot. Do not guess

host contamination - sleep, wake, DarkWake, a closed lid, or battery at or below 20%
any code, test, harness, methodology, fetch-policy or migration change becoming necessary
a session or tool limit threatening safe completion
